headline: Earnings edge higher while cash reserves shrink sharply
summary_short: First Hawaiian's diluted EPS was $0.60 (+3.4% y/y) as revenue rose 6.3% y/y to $231.3M and net income was roughly flat at $73.4M, while total cash fell 27.6% y/y to $1,012.5M.
summary_long: Revenue rose 6.3% y/y to $231.3M. Net income was $73.4M, up 0.2% y/y (essentially flat); net margin was 31.7% versus 33.7% a year earlier, down about 195bp. Pretax income rose 8.1% y/y to $95.2M. Diluted EPS was $0.60, up 3.4% y/y. Weighted diluted shares fell 2.8% y/y to 122.3M. Total cash fell 27.6% y/y to $1,012.5M. Shareholders' equity rose 4.9% y/y to $2,826.0M.
